blocks.text: CAIRO— (UPDATED) A Saudi-led coalition fighting Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen said a projectile struck a passenger terminal at the international airport in Riyadh on Sunday, less than a day after a missile struck it and killed 12 people. There were no immediate details about the latest strike, which hit the same complex housing terminals 3 and 4 for domestic flights. The sharp escalation in the new front in the Iran war threatens to draw in greater U.S. military involvement as President Donald Trump has said he is weighing joining the fight against the rebels.
